content.short: Gnosis Chain is an Ethereum sidechain run by a community of over 100k validators with lower gas fees than Ethereum mainnet.
content.description: Gnosis Chain is an Ethereum-compatible sidechain that provides the native infrastructure for the Gnosis DApp ecosystem, including protocols, Vaults, and many other projects. You can participate by running a validator to help improve accessibility and resilience across the network. Solidity developers can take advantage of fast block times and low gas fees to design, deploy, and experiment with smart contracts for their own use cases within this open-source chain.
content.meta: Gnosis Chain is an Ethereum sidechain that powers the Gnosis DApp ecosystem. Discover Gnosis Chain and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: What Is a Smart Wallet?
resources.tldr: Rather than one secret key plus a written backup, the account is a contract that can authorise spending from a fingerprint or face scan.

resources.title: What Is a Seed Phrase, and Why You Might Not Need One
resources.tldr: Twelve or 24 words that are the master key to everything in a wallet. Lose them and the money is gone — which is exactly the problem.

resources.title: Choosing a Non-Custodial Wallet
resources.tldr: A plain-English guide arguing the right answer depends on what you actually do with crypto, not on which wallet has the longest feature list.
